content.short: Boardroom is a DAO management tool helping members make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions.
content.description: Boardroom is a management dashboard designed for active DAO participants and stakeholders. DAOs depend on broad participation and informed decision‑making, but much governance information remains siloed across tools. Boardroom provides voters with a comprehensive, user‑friendly governance dashboard that increases transparency and participation in project decision‑making. The Governance API exposes governance data to developers, and the Teams feature consolidates tracking, voting, communications, and reporting workflows to support organized governance management.
